name: player_rebuild_above_ground_indices
description: Player::RebuildAboveGroundIndices compacts set above-ground probe flags into the above-ground index array.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to the Player environment-probe selector pass so global placement, loop shape, and caller context can be compared together.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja HLIL for 0x42cf60 validates iteration from 0 to g_PlayerEnvProbeSampleCount, appending sampleIndex to g_PlayerEnvProbe_AboveGroundIndices when g_PlayerEnvProbe_AboveGroundFlags[sampleIndex] is nonzero, with no stale-tail clearing.
The native smoke verifies compacted index order and that the first stale tail entry remains untouched.
